I didn't take more than my fair share, and I didn't take it without permission because it's expected that guests will have some cake. There's no indication that taking the cake was against the host's wishes or any rules of the party.

I don't see any moral wrongdoing here. It's a normal social interaction, and taking a piece of cake is expected and acceptable.
